Gradski Parking Tuzla is a Progressive Web Application (PWA) designed to simplify vehicle parking in Tuzla, Bosnia and Herzegovina. It integrates interactive OpenStreetMap visualization, GPS navigation, SMS payment automation, parking zone management, and offline support.

Overview
Name: Gradski Parking Tuzla

Type: Mobile-first Progressive Web Application (PWA)

Organization: AISO Tuzla

License: MIT

Target Audience: Drivers, residents, commuters, and tourists navigating Tuzla.

Languages Supported: Bosnian (bs), English (en), German (de).

Core Capabilities & Features
Smart Parking Management
Zone Visualization: Real-time visual overlays for Zone 0, Zone 1, and Zone 2 parking areas in Tuzla.

Price Transparency: Provides official city parking rates per zone and tracks active working hours dynamically.

SMS Payment Automation: Generates pre-formatted SMS payment requests for local parking operators.

Parking Timers: Built-in expiration timers and alerts for paid parking sessions.

Closest Parking Finder: Identifies nearest available parking locations based on live GPS location.

Navigation & Mapping
Interactive Maps: Built with Leaflet and Geoapify Maps on top of OpenStreetMap data.

Route Calculation: Provides turn-by-turn navigation and optimal routes to selected parking zones.

Offline Mode: Map tiles and critical parking data remain functional without active cellular connectivity using Service Workers.

Technical Architecture
Frontend Framework: React with TypeScript

Styling & UI: TailwindCSS, Lucide Icons

Mapping Stack: Leaflet, Geoapify API, OpenStreetMap

Application Type: Installable PWA with offline caching capabilities

Project Structure
src/components/ - UI components (maps, parking details, payment modal, navigation controls).

src/services/ - External API integrations (Geoapify, geolocation, offline tile caching).

src/data/ - Static datasets including zone coordinates, pricing rules, and SMS gateways.

src/hooks/ - Custom React hooks for GPS tracking, timers, and offline status.

src/utils/ - Utility functions for SMS link generation, distance calculation, and time detection.

src/types/ - TypeScript type definitions for parking zones, coordinates, and app state.
